Introduction

CORTIS (short for Colour Outside The Lines) is a five-member kpop boy group under BigHit Music. The lineup consists of James, Juhoon, Martin, Seonghyeon, and Keonho.

The group was first introduced by BigHit Music in April 2025, with the agency describing them as a "next-generation creator crew" due to their active involvement in songwriting, choreography, and visual production. Prior to debut, members also contributed to projects for senior HYBE artists.

CORTIS released their pre-debut single "GO!" on August 11, 2025. The track combined Y2K-inspired elements with trap beats and synths, giving audiences an early look into their experimental direction. One week later, on August 18, 2025, they officially debuted with the single "What You Want," a fusion of psychedelic rock and hip-hop.

The group’s first extended play, Color Outside the Lines, was officially released on September 8, 2025.
